title: 第一卷 第9章 竟是符师传承第一卷 第10章 青云山坊市
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: “什么古籍？”林寻眼中闪过一丝困惑。
区区凡间古籍，用得着这样大张旗鼓？
“对！”杨父左右看了一圈，凑近林寻耳边道，
“其实不光抓了我们，整个县内的不少当铺掌柜都被抓了。”说着他指了指地上的几人，
“这几位，就是附近乡镇的掌柜。”
“嗯？竟有此事？”林寻更加好奇。
“县衙要找的就是一本古籍，上面绘有花鸟图画，还有符箓字文。”
“那和你有什么关系？”
“一个月前响水镇来了位游方道士，到我当铺中兑了本古籍，我感觉，这就是他们要找的。
这与县衙所述极为相似。”
游方道士？
绘有花鸟图案，符箓字文？
难道还和修仙者有关？
林寻心中一动，瞬间就有了猜测。
“原来如此，那你怎么未将此事告知县衙，也可免了牢狱之灾。”林寻按捺下心思，继续发问。
杨父苦笑，
“你也看到了如今的情况，县衙为了这件事情，将有关人都关了起来，一旦确定我手中的书籍，就是县衙所寻。
到时候连杨芸恐怕也会遭受大难。”
“嗯，倒是明事理。”林寻微微点头，杨父所说完全有可能。
事关修仙，还做的如此谨慎，一旦被确认恐怕所有知情者都落不着好。
他打量一番四周，有些遗憾。
以现在的能力，断然无法悄无声息的带两人离开，只能再做打算。
想到这里，林寻拱了拱手，
“两位还要再受苦一段时间，等我想到安全之法，定然前来搭救。”
“好！如此便多谢了，只是......”杨父同样抱了一拳，接着道，“只是希望你好生对待芸儿，她从小就很少吃苦......”
林寻呵呵笑着，“放心，我必定不会亏待她。”
片刻之后，在守兵尚未察觉的情况下，他安全离开牢房。
客栈内。
林寻掖了掖被子坐起身。
没想到，杨氏父子还给他带来了好消息，也不知道古籍里到底是什么？
既然如此，就先回镇中，找到古籍再去寻找坊市。
若古籍是一本功法，他就算不能修炼，也能拿去贩卖，这样的话，还能多些修炼粮资。
若是术法，也能多些保命手段，好像具体是什么都不亏。
办完事后还是先回镇上吧。
做下决定后，林寻才再次入睡。
次日，林寻就前往县衙的鸳鸯楼，打算找媒婆寻个妾室，也好给芸儿分担。
最主要的是想开新枝丫。
林寻的出手异常大方，媒婆将所有未出阁的姑娘画卷都拿出来，供他挑选。
但可惜，半个时辰后，没有找到任何合适的人。
环肥燕瘦，莺莺燕燕。
还有不少女子，琴棋书画，吹箫弄玉，样样精通。
但宝树偏偏没有反应。
他也只能无奈作罢，丢下二十两银子后才飘然离去。
只能再苦一苦芸儿了。
content_en:
"What ancient book?" A trace of confusion flashed in Lin Xun's eyes.
Does a mere mortal ancient book need such a big fanfare?
"Yes!" Father Yang looked around, then leaned into Lin Xun's ear and whispered,
"Actually, not only were we arrested, but many pawnshop owners throughout the county were arrested." As he spoke, he pointed to a few people on the ground.
"These are the shopkeepers from nearby towns."
"Huh? Is this happening?" Lin Xun was even more curious.
"What the county government is looking for is an ancient book with pictures of flowers and birds on it, as well as talismans and inscriptions."
"What does that have to do with you?"
"A month ago, a wandering Taoist priest came to Xiangshui Town and bought an ancient book from my pawn shop. I felt that this was what they were looking for.
This is very similar to what the county government said. "
Wandering Taoist priest?
Painted with patterns of flowers and birds, talismans and characters?
Is it still related to the cultivators?
Lin Xun's heart moved, and he immediately had a guess.
"I see, then why didn't you tell the county government about this? You could have avoided jail." Lin Xun suppressed his thoughts and continued to ask questions.
Father Yang smiled bitterly,
"You have also seen the current situation. The county government has locked up all the relevant people for this matter. Once it is determined that the book in my hand is what the county government is looking for.
By then, even Yang Yun may suffer a catastrophe. "
"Well, that makes sense." Lin Xun nodded slightly. What Father Yang said was entirely possible.
It is related to cultivating immortality, and it is done so cautiously. Once it is confirmed, I am afraid that everyone who knows about it will be in trouble.
He looked around and felt a little regretful.
With the current ability, it is absolutely impossible to take the two people away quietly, so they can only make further plans.
Thinking of this, Lin Xun cupped his hands.
"You two will have to suffer for a while longer. When I think of a safe way, I will definitely come to rescue you."
"Okay! Thank you very much for that, but..." Yang's father also hugged a fist, and then said, "I just hope you treat Yun'er well. She has rarely endured hardship since she was a child..."
Lin Xun chuckled, "Don't worry, I won't treat her badly."
Moments later, without the guards noticing, he left the cell safely.
Inside the inn.
Lin Xun tucked in the quilt and sat up.
Unexpectedly, Yang and his son brought him good news, and he didn't know what it was in the ancient book?
In this case, go back to the town first, find the ancient books, and then go to the market.
If the ancient book is a cultivation method, even if he cannot practice it, he can still sell it. In this case, he can get more food for cultivation.
If it is magic, it can also provide more life-saving means, and it seems that nothing will be lost.
After finishing, let's go back to town first.
After making the decision, Lin Xun fell asleep again.
The next day, Lin Xun went to the Yuanyang Tower of the county government office, planning to find a matchmaker to find a concubine so that Yun'er could share the burden.
The most important thing is to open new branches.
Lin Xun was unusually generous in his approach. The matchmaker took out all the pictures of girls who had not left the court for him to choose from.
But unfortunately, after half an hour, no suitable person was found.
The ring is fat and the swallows are thin, and the swallows are wary and wary.
There are also many women who are proficient in playing piano, chess, calligraphy, painting, flute and jade.
But Baoshu didn't respond.
He had no choice but to give up and leave after leaving twenty taels of silver.
I can only suffer one more bitter Yun'er.
